opening.en: I also resigned from the House on November 8. Do not add an office I never actually held to my service record.

response.speaker: player
response.ko: 가필드는 대통령에 당선되어 {{blank}} 의석을 수락하지 않았습니다.
response.en: After his presidential victory Garfield declined the {{blank}} seat.

correct.speaker: npc:0
correct.ko: 상원에 선출되었지만 실제 재임하지 않은 경력을 별도 표시하고 대통령 취임 전에는 당선자로 기록하세요.
correct.en: Mark election to the Senate without service separately and identify the president-elect before accession.

incorrect.speaker: npc:0
incorrect.ko: 가필드는 1880년 상원에 선출됐지만 대통령 당선으로 상원 의석을 사양했습니다.
incorrect.en: Garfield declined the Senate seat after winning the presidency.

incorrect.speaker: player
incorrect.ko: 당선과 실제 취임을 합친 연표를 수정하겠습니다.
incorrect.en: I'll correct the timeline that merges election and actual accession.

evidence.claim: Garfield was elected to the Senate in January 1880 but declined the seat after winning the presidency November 2.
